technical_depth.question: How much hands-on engineering depth does the candidate demonstrate?
technical_depth.instructions: Use concrete evidence of what the candidate personally designed, built, tested, debugged, or shipped. Ignore skills lists, titles, and company names. Score demonstrated depth, not years worked.
criteria: Technical collaboration with little evidence of personally building software
Independently designs and builds production features end to end
Owns complex systems, architecture, integrations, data models, and production tradeoffs
Deep specialist or systems-level engineering ownership at significant scale

primary_profile.question: Which profile best describes the candidate based on demonstrated work?
primary_profile.instructions: Use evidence from work bullets and weight recent experience most heavily. Do not infer from titles alone.

criteria.product_manager: Primarily defines product direction and coordinates delivery.
criteria.technical_product_manager: Product ownership with substantial architecture, API, data, or platform depth.
criteria.product_engineer: Personally moves between product definition and hands-on implementation.
criteria.software_engineer: Primarily owns implementation and technical systems.
criteria.forward_deployed_engineer: Combines engineering with direct stakeholder problem solving and deployment.

llm_experience.question: Does the resume demonstrate practical experience using LLMs or coding agents to build production software?
llm_experience.instructions: Return true only when experience bullets demonstrate practical use of LLMs, agents, evaluations, or AI-assisted implementation. Do not infer from a skills list alone.
